content:
Hannah T: Hi all - tiny onboarding panic 😅 I started Tuesday 4/9 and there's a company holiday next Friday. Am I eligible for holiday pay? Also my corporate card is still in transit and I paid for a movers tip + parking on my personal card. Can that be reimbursed quickly?
People Ops: Welcome Hannah! :tada: Holiday pay: usually yes if payroll shows you as active before the payroll cutoff for that run. I'll check the cutoff and post it here. For the movers/parking, two options: virtual Ramp card or off-cycle reimbursement via Concur + ops email.
Ravi S: Payroll note: cutoff is the Thursday before payroll at 5pm PT for our biweekly run. If your hire paperwork (W-4 + direct deposit) was entered before that, holiday pay should appear. PTO accrual begins on day 1 but amounts shown on the first paystub are prorated.
Hannah T: I did the W-4 and set direct deposit during onboarding, should be in the portal. If I want off-cycle, what exact info do you need?
People Ops: For off-cycle: 1) Submit a Concur expense and tag it "onboarding-move". 2) Email ops@redwood.com with the Concur link, attach receipts, include manager approval (or cc manager). Subject: "Off-cycle reimbursement - new hire". We'll route to finance; typical ETA 2-3 business days after approvals.
Finance Bot: Automated: off-cycle payments require manager + ops approvals and are subject to bank cutoff windows.
Leah G: FYI: I had the same issue onboarding - Ramp virtual card was fastest. People Ops issued a virtual card same day and finance cleared the charge within 24 hours.
Hannah T: If I request the virtual card, how do I pay back any personal charges already made?
People Ops: If you already paid personally, either submit Concur for those receipts (we'll off-cycle) or, if you prefer, we can issue the virtual card and also reimburse earlier receipts via the same off-cycle flow. Upload receipts for both.
Ravi S: I'll DM payroll to confirm the exact cutoff timestamp for the upcoming holiday run and post here once they reply. Also DM me your employee ID and the confirmation number from the benefits portal if you'd like me to verify enrollment status.
Hannah T: Thanks all - DMing now. Appreciate the quick help! :heart:
